From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Reference consent + quick usage ask for renewal

Hi Jordan,

Hope you’re well — and congrats again on the smooth integration last year. PulseWare’s annual renewal for the Redwood Dedicated contract is coming up next month, and we’re pulling together a short set of references and verified outcomes to share with our renewal committee and for the internal exec summary.

Would PulseWare be willing to provide:
- A short 1–2 paragraph customer quote about business outcomes (up to 2 sentences about ROI or impact would be great)
- Permission to publish the PulseWare logo and a single verified metric (we’ll ask for confirmation of the usage stat below)

Attached is a usage snapshot we pulled (pulseware_usage_snapshot_Q1-Q2.csv) and a quick two-paragraph quote template (quote_template_2para.docx) to make it easier. If you’re open to this, we also need a signed reference release form (I’ve attached the standard PDF).

Specific metric we’d like to confirm for the case study: average inference tokens per day and % reduction in latency since migration to Redwood Dedicated (we show ~28% latency improvement in the snapshot). Confirming that one metric + a short quote is all we need.

If you’re game I can coordinate legal sign-off on the release form — or Ben can route the DocuSign with procurement. Would 3 business days be reasonable for a response?

Thanks so much,

—Marissa

Hi Jordan / Lena / procurement team,

Thanks again for being open to this. To make the ask as frictionless as possible, below is the exact text and the single metric we’d like confirmation on. Please feel free to edit.

Suggested public quote (2 sentences):
“PulseWare has seen measurable improvements in inference latency since migrating to Redwood Dedicated. The shorter response times have helped our operations team scale client throughput without increasing GPU spend.”

Metric to confirm: 
"28% average reduction in median inference latency (ms) after moving to Redwood Dedicated, measured across Q1–Q2 2027 workload."

What we need from you:
- A quick reply agreeing to the quote and the metric as written (or an edited version)
- A signed reference release form (DocuSign link below) — this authorizes use of the quote, logo, and the single verified metric in marketing and the renewal packet

DocuSign (reference_release_form): https://www.docusign.com/receiver/abc123-release
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/449

If you confirm, we’ll publish a short case note and include the quote in our internal renewal materials. We’re happy to offer a one-time invoice credit as a thank-you for publishing a short public case study — Ben will include specifics in the DocuSign envelope.

Could you let us know by EOD next Wednesday (May 26)? If procurement needs anything else I can loop in Legal.

Appreciate it — Marissa
